answer: Proof-of-stake identity verification offers robust Sybil resistance for agent networks. Agents must stake capital on a digital terrace of validated nodes to earn the right to signal consensus weight. The cost of entry is a saffron premium of staked collateral, which creates a strictly proportional financial barrier. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities must commit significant capital, ensuring that the economic cost of subverting the signal outweighs any potential exploit gains.
